credit_grants_expiry_sweep_idx.name: credit_grants_expiry_sweep_idx
credit_grants_expiry_sweep_idx.where: status = 'active' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

credit_reservations_state_fields.name: credit_reservations_state_fields
credit_reservations_state_fields.value:
("credit_reservations"."status" = 'active' AND "credit_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL AND "credit_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("credit_reservations"."status" = 'settled' AND "credit_reservations"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL)
    OR (("credit_reservations"."status" = 'released' OR "credit_reservations"."status" = 'expired') AND "credit_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL AND "credit_reservations"."released_at" IS NOT NULL)

papers_question_state.name: papers_question_state
papers_question_state.value:
("papers"."question_status" = 'resolved' AND "papers"."question_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "papers"."question_text" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("papers"."question_text")) > 0 AND length("papers"."question_text") <= 2000)
    OR ("papers"."question_status" = 'thinking' AND "papers"."question_resolved_at" IS NULL AND "papers"."question_text" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("papers"."question_text")) > 0 AND length("papers"."question_text") <= 2000)
    OR ("papers"."question_status" = 'none' AND "papers"."question_resolved_at" IS NULL AND "papers"."question_text" IS NULL)

study_sessions_state_fields.name: study_sessions_state_fields
study_sessions_state_fields.value:
("study_sessions"."status" = 'running' AND "study_sessions"."paused_at" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."duration_seconds" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."completion_source" IS NULL)
    OR ("study_sessions"."status" = 'paused' AND "study_sessions"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "study_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."duration_seconds" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."completion_source" IS NULL)
    OR ("study_sessions"."status" = 'completed' AND "study_sessions"."paused_at" IS NULL AND "study_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "study_sessions"."duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "study_sessions"."completion_source" IN ('online', 'offline_sync'))

study_sessions_paper_source.name: study_sessions_paper_source
study_sessions_paper_source.value:
("study_sessions"."source" IN ('desktop_capture', 'desktop_existing_question') AND "study_sessions"."paper_id" IS NOT NULL AND "study_sessions"."topic_id" IS NULL)
    OR "study_sessions"."source" = 'manual_topic'
